leadText: (Japanese: フロードの過去 Fraud's Past) is the 71st chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

(Japanese: フロードの過去 Fraud's Past) is the 71st chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
While Ryouga faces off against Arcades' caretaker, Rug discovers the tracer on Yappy's bag.
Fraud arrives on the island.
Fraud's past as a young man is revealed.
Fraud is confronted by Rug and Karuta.
